violations.text: Whole shell eggs were observed stored above ready to eat items in the Dairy end cooler. Eggs are to be moved for proper storage to the bottom shelf under any items that are considered ready to eat. Eggs relocated at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink in the Meat Dpt. was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 ppm. The chemical mixing unit nozzle was removed and unclogged, and sanitizer solution was retested at the proper concentration of 200-400 ppm at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Several soups in the prepared foods open air cooler were observed at 43-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Soups observed at 45 degrees F or above were voluntarily disposed of, and soups observed at 43-44 degrees F were moved for cooling and proper cold holding at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

At the time of inspection, Reduced Oxygen Packaged Salmon labeled keep frozen was observed stored in a Prepared Foods Area cold hold unit at 39 degrees Fahrenheit. REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGED FISH that bears a label indicating that it is to be kept frozen until time of use shall be removed from the reduced oxygen environment prior to its thawing under refrigeration. Due to temperature observed at and time it was placed into the cooler unit from the freezer (previous day), the ROP salmon was voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Proper thawing of frozen ROP seafood was discussed with the PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Several working containers of dry ingredients in the bakery and prepared foods kitchen areas are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The 2 left side garage doors to the outside, located in the back receiving area, are not tight-fitting (gap at base weather stripping). Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

The sinks used for food preparation at the Prepared Foods Kitchen are both lacking proper air gaps (currently equipped with an air break). The ends of the drainpipes are to be adjusted so as to not end below the flood rim of the drains they are directed into. New Violation. Correct By: 11/18/2026

The area outside of the Prepared Foods Kitchen being used for food preparation is lacking a hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink is to be installed to allow for convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. New Violation. Correct By: 12/30/2024

Several food items packaged in the food establishment (Bakery and Prepared Foods) are lacking labels with complete information. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of all ingredients and allergens, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 12/30/2024

The door to the outside, located in the ice machine area, is not tight-fitting (Gap at the base of the door). Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 12/30/2024

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of in containers of food items. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/16/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the following were observed to have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris... - The bakery mixer machines - Shared deli/prepared foods walk-in cooler fan shrouds, light shield(s), and ceiling - Base of dairy milk storage coolers under shelving Non-FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. New Violation. Correct By: 12/21/2024
